# HairMirror

> HairMirror is a web-based AI hairstyle preview tool. A signed-in user uploads one front-facing photo and compares three hairstyle directions before deciding on a haircut.

## Canonical pages

- [Home](https://web-production-eeda8.up.railway.app/): Product overview, examples, and hairstyle studio
- [Pricing](https://web-production-eeda8.up.railway.app/pricing): Current personal pack and salon plan pricing
- [FAQ](https://web-production-eeda8.up.railway.app/faq): Product, billing, privacy, and result-limit answers
- [Privacy Policy](https://web-production-eeda8.up.railway.app/privacy): Photo processing, retention, deletion, and service providers
- [Terms of Service](https://web-production-eeda8.up.railway.app/terms): Account, billing, cancellation, and acceptable-use terms

## Product facts

- Sign-in is required before uploading a photo.
- A new account receives one free complete preview with three hairstyle directions.
- The Personal Preview Pack costs $1.99 USD and includes five complete previews. Credits do not expire; failed or cancelled jobs do not consume a credit.
- Salon Pro costs $29 USD per month and includes 200 complete previews shared by the salon owner and staff accounts.
- Source photos are deleted after successful generation or cancellation. After repeated failure, source photos are retained for no more than 24 hours.
- Generated results and related choices are retained for 30 days by default and can be deleted sooner.
- AI previews are planning references, not guarantees of an identical real-world haircut.

For the most current price, tax, and billing terms, use the HairMirror pricing page and the linked Gumroad checkout.
